name: What is grout replacement and why is it necessary?

mainEntity.name: What is grout replacement and why is it necessary?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grout replacement involves removing old, deteriorated grout from between tiles and installing new grout. Over time, grout can crack, crumble, stain, or become moldy due to moisture, wear, and cleaning chemicals. Replacing it improves the appearance of your tiled surfaces, prevents water infiltration that can damage subfloors or walls, and maintains a hygienic environment. It's a crucial maintenance step to extend the life of your tile installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Grout replacement removes old, damaged grout and installs new to improve appearance, prevent water damage, and maintain hygiene.
